contract.pointerLifetime: Call-data pointers are borrowed for the synchronous call unless the selected header explicitly says otherwise. Copy returned service tables into add-on-owned storage.
contract.compatibilityRule: Check the requested ABI version, returned function pointers, host capabilities, runtime identity, and every result code before using a service.

interfaces.name: Add-on host
interfaces.purpose: Register add-ons, declare effects and capabilities, own resources, and retire cleanly.
interfaces.whenToUse: Start here for every native UNBSE add-on. The returned owner handle ties later registrations and retirement to your add-on.

functions.name: getHostCapabilities
functions.returns: Bitwise UNBSEAddonHostCapabilityV1 flags supported by the loaded host.
functions.use: Gate optional integrations before registering or querying their services.

functions.name: registerAddon
functions.signature: uint32_t registerAddon(const UNBSEAddonDescriptorV1* descriptor, UNBSEAddonRegistrationV1* registration)
functions.use: Declare a stable add-on ID, version, effects, and required host capabilities; receive the owner handle and compatibility result.

functions.name: retireAddon
functions.use: Stop accepting owned work and retire the add-on before its DLL unloads.

functions.name: resultName
functions.returns: A readable name for a UNBSEAddonResultCodeV1 value.
functions.use: Add a readable result name to diagnostics without replacing numeric result handling.

functions.name: queryScriptService
functions.returns: Non-zero when the requested script-service table is available.
functions.use: Discover the script service through the registered host table.

interfaces.name: Messaging
interfaces.purpose: Register in-process listeners and dispatch bounded synchronous messages.
interfaces.whenToUse: Coordinate independent add-ons without linking them together. Copy any data needed after a callback because message data is borrowed only for that callback.

functions.name: registerListener
functions.signature: uint32_t registerListener(uint32_t ownerHandle, const char* senderFilter, UNBSEMessageCallbackV1 callback, void* context)
functions.use: Register one owner-scoped synchronous message callback.

functions.name: dispatch
functions.signature: uint32_t dispatch(uint32_t senderOwnerHandle, uint32_t messageType, const void* data, uint32_t dataSize, const char* receiverId)
functions.use: Deliver a bounded payload to matching listeners during the call.

functions.name: resultName
functions.returns: A readable name for a UNBSEMessagingResultCodeV1 value.
functions.use: Add readable diagnostics while retaining numeric result handling.

callbacks.name: UNBSEMessageCallbackV1
callbacks.signature: void callback(const UNBSEMessageV1* message, void* context)
callbacks.use: Handle a matching message synchronously; copy any payload data needed after the callback returns.

interfaces.name: Script service
interfaces.purpose: Register namespaced native functions for supported script runtimes.
interfaces.whenToUse: Expose a small typed native function to a supported script VM. Check capability flags because registration alone does not prove that a particular VM is available.

functions.name: getCapabilities
functions.returns: Bitwise UNBSEScriptCapabilityV1 flags supported by the loaded service.
functions.use: Detect declaration support and each available script/runtime integration.

functions.name: registerFunction
functions.signature: uint32_t registerFunction(uint32_t ownerHandle, const UNBSEScriptFunctionDeclarationV1* declaration)
functions.use: Publish an owner-scoped, namespaced function with explicit argument and result types.

functions.name: retireOwner
functions.use: Stop script dispatch to an owner and wait up to the supplied deadline for active work to retire.

callbacks.name: UNBSEScriptFunctionV1
callbacks.signature: void callback(const UNBSEScriptInvocationV1* invocation, UNBSEScriptResultV1* result, void* context)
callbacks.returns: No direct value; write the code, value, and diagnostic into result.
callbacks.use: Validate the typed arguments, complete synchronously, and populate the result before the invocation deadline.

interfaces.name: Runtime information
interfaces.purpose: Read the loaded executable, platform, and foundation identity.
interfaces.whenToUse: Verify the observed executable and host version before selecting version-specific behavior or relative addresses. Identity describes what is loaded; it does not declare your add-on compatible.

interfaces.name: Relocation
interfaces.purpose: Resolve an executable-relative address after ownership and bounds checks.
interfaces.whenToUse: After validating runtime identity, convert an RVA selected for that exact game build into an in-process address. Bounds checks do not prove that the selected address has compatible behavior.

functions.name: resolve
functions.signature: uint32_t resolve(const UNBSERelocationRequestV1* request, UNBSERelocationResultV1* result)
functions.use: Validate owner, module, image bounds, and arithmetic before returning an absolute executable address.

functions.name: resultName
functions.returns: A readable name for a UNBSERelocationResultCodeV1 value.
functions.use: Add readable diagnostics while retaining numeric result handling.

workflows.title: Use a version-specific game address
workflows.rule: Match the observed executable identity to an address table your add-on explicitly supports before calling resolve.

workflows.title: Expose a native function to scripts
workflows.rule: Use a stable namespace, validate argument types in the callback, and return before the invocation deadline.

workflows.title: Exchange an in-process add-on message
workflows.rule: Treat the payload as borrowed for the synchronous callback and keep it within the published byte limit.
